To handle this problem of incomplete infor- mation, we construct two models: sequence-based SVM model and structure-based SVM model. The sequence- based model utilizes physicochemical features, PSSM, evolutionary conservation score, and sequence entropy, which comprises no structure information. And the structure-based model uses physicochemical features, ASA, and biochemical contacts without sequence infor- mation. The prediction results are compared by preci- sion (P), recall (R), F1-score (F1), and AUC (area under ROC curve). In our work, F1 and AUC bear importance, since F1 score measures the balance precision and recall rates and AUC is independent of any decision threshold.
